# Third-party attributions

This directory holds attribution copies of third-party license texts that
apply to dependencies of Hellproof which are **never vendored or committed**
to this repository, so that the required copyright/license notices are still
available for redistribution compliance.

- `FREEDOOM-COPYING.txt`: verbatim `COPYING.adoc` from the
  [Freedoom](https://freedoom.github.io/) project (BSD-3-Clause), fetched
  from https://github.com/freedoom/freedoom on 2026-09-12. Freedoom `.wad`
  asset files themselves are never committed to this repository (see
  `REUSE.toml` and `RISKS.md` R9); only their license text is reproduced
  here for attribution.
